text: At its meeting on September 13, 2022, the TO Live – St. Lawrence Centre Redevelopment Committee considered RL11.1 and made recommendations to the Board of Directors of TO Live. Summary from the report (August 31, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live: The purpose of this report is to provide the Board of Directors of TO Live with an update on the StLC redevelopment project. City Council, at its meeting on May 11, 2022, adopted EX32.10 which included recommendations from the Board and CreateTO. The Vice President of St. Lawrence Centre Redevelopment will provide an update at the Committee meeting.
The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Received the report (August 31, 2022) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live for information.
